DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた連絡についてのご相談と伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like advice about a message you received.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメッセージに、今日中に手続きをしないといけないと書いてあります。本物か心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日中の手続きを求めるメッセージの真偽が心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: This message says I must complete a procedure by the end of today. I am worried whether it is genuine.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are concerned about the authenticity of a message demanding a procedure today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送信元や本文を確認します。リンクを開いたり、情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the sender and text. Have you opened a link or entered any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。ただ、本文に電話番号も書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンクと入力は未実施だが本文に番号があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have done neither. But there is also a phone number in the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not opened the link or entered information, but a number is written in the message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本文の連絡先をそのまま信用せず、確認先を別に調べる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than simply trust the contact in the message, you need to find a verification contact separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで書かれている番号へ電話する前に、誰に確認するか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記載番号へ急いで電話する前に確認相手を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before rushing to call the number in it, I would like to know whom to check with.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to know whom to verify with before rushing to call the written number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの機関からの通知を名乗っているか、担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will check which organization the notice claims to be from.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名乗っている機関名はここです。期限の話も、まだ信用しないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名乗る機関名を示し期限も未確認と理解したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the organization name it gives. So I should not trust the stated deadline yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the claimed organization name and say that you understand the deadline is also unverified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限を含めて真偽の確認が必要です。画面は消さず、担当者に見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: The authenticity, including the deadline, needs checking. Do not dismiss the screen; show it to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この画面を保存して、独立した連絡先を確認するまで操作を止めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を保存して独立した連絡先を確かめるまで操作を止めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will save this screen and stop taking any action until I have checked an independent contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will save the screen and stop acting until an independent contact has been checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者へおつなぎします。そのまま画面を保ち、こちらの相談席へお進みください。私は受付へ戻りますので、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put you in touch with the staff in charge. Keep the screen as it is and go to this consultation seat. I will return to reception. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬剤師です。お薬についてお困りのことを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: I am the pharmacist. Please tell me what difficulty you are having with your medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にある薬の説明書をなくしました。箱はあるのですが、使い方を自己判断したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明書をなくし箱だけでは使い方を判断したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost the instructions for medicine I have at home. I have the box, but I do not want to decide how to use it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you lost the instructions and do not want to judge how to use the medicine from the box alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の製品名がわかるようにお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the box so I can see the product name?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この箱です。前に買ったものと似ていますが、同じか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱を示し似た薬と同じか確信がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the box. It looks like something I bought before, but I am not sure it is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the box and say that you are not sure it is the same as a similar medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは判断せず、製品名などを私が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than judging by appearance alone, I will check the product name and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかに使っている薬の名前も伝えたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ほかに使用する薬の名前も伝える必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I also tell you the names of other medicines I am using?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to give the names of other medicines you use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 併用中の薬など、相談に必要な情報を確認します。お持ちの情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check information needed for the consultation, including medicines used together. Have you brought any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お薬手帳を持っています。わからない名前は、この記録を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: お薬手帳で不明な薬の名前を確認してもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my medication record book. I would like you to look at this record for names I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want unknown medicine names checked in your medication record book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご相談の際に箱と手帳を一緒にお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please present the box and record book together when discussing this.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬剤師の説明を聞いて、理解できないところはその場で聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬剤師の説明を聞き不明点をその場で聞き返すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will listen to the pharmacist's explanation and ask again on the spot about anything I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will listen to the pharmacist and immediately ask again about unclear points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では箱と手帳を一緒に拝見します。不明な点を残さず相談してからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will look at the box and book together. Please discuss anything unclear before leaving rather than leaving questions unanswered.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 試着用の靴を用意しましたが、履く前に表示も一緒に確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: I have prepared shoes for you to try. Would you like to check the labels together before putting them on?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。ただ、この箱と靴のサイズが違って見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱と靴でサイズが違って見えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. But the sizes on this box and the shoes seem different.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the sizes on the box and shoes seem different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱は隣の商品かもしれません。靴の表示と商品番号を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: The box may belong to the product beside it. I will check the shoe label and product number.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 確認してから試します。右だけでなく左も履いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示を確かめ両足を試してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will try them after checking. May I put on the left one as well as the right?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the labeling and ask whether you may try both feet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両足でお試しください。店内の確認用の場所で歩いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please try both. You can walk in the designated fitting-check area inside the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左足のほうがきついです。同じ形で少し大きいものを探せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左足が窮屈なため同型の大きいサイズを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: The left foot feels tighter. Can we look for a slightly larger size in the same style?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a larger size in the same style because the left foot feels cramped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 在庫を調べます。購入後のサイズ変更についてもご案内を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check stock. Would you also like to check the policy on changing sizes after purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その条件も知りたいです。外で履く前と後では扱いが違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 屋外で履く前後でサイズ変更の扱いが異なるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know those conditions too. Is it handled differently before and after wearing them outside?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether size-change treatment differs before and after wearing shoes outdoors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 具体的な条件は、この練習店舗の案内を担当者とご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the specific conditions, please check this practice shop's information with the staff in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別のサイズを試してから案内を読み、靴と箱の表示が一致したものを購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別サイズと条件を確認し箱と実物の表示を照合して買うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will try another size, then read the information and buy a pair whose shoe and box labels match.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check another size and conditions, and compare the box and actual shoe labels before buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品と箱を照合してお渡しします。履き心地を確かめてから、納得のいく一足をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will compare the product and box before giving them to you. Check the fit and choose a pair you are happy with.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の確認から承ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will begin by checking your reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行のメモと予約メールでホテルの名前が少し違います。ここで合っているか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅程メモと予約メールのホテル名が違い場所を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: The hotel names in my travel notes and reservation email differ slightly. I want to check whether this is the right place.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the hotel names in your itinerary notes and reservation email differ and you want to check the location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約メールの施設名と宿泊日を拝見してもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the property name and stay dates in your reservation email?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面です。明日からの予約になっているようですが、私は今日泊まるつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メールは明日開始だが今日宿泊予定だったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the screen. It seems the booking starts tomorrow, but I intended to stay today.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the email starts tomorrow but you planned to stay today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付の食い違いがありますね。予約内容を確認するまで、チェックインできるとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: The dates do not match. Until we check the reservation details, I cannot tell you that you can check in.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私のメモが間違ったかもしれません。予約したサイトも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メモの誤りの可能性を認め予約サイトも確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: My notes may be wrong. I will also check the website where I booked.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that your notes may be wrong and say that you will check the booking website too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約番号を用意して、どの窓口で確認するべきか相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Prepare the reservation number, and let us discuss which desk you should check with.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号はここにあります。空き部屋の相談と、元の予約の変更は別に聞いたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約番号を示し空室と元予約変更を別々に相談するべきか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is here. Should I ask separately about available rooms and changes to my original booking?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the reservation number and ask whether to discuss vacancies and changes to the original booking separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれ確認先と条件を整理します。追加の予約を決める前にご案内を聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will sort out whom to ask and the conditions for each. Please hear the guidance before deciding on an additional reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず予約の日付を確認し、変更できるかと今日の宿泊方法を分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約日を確認して変更可否と本日の宿泊手段を分けて相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will check the booking date, then separately discuss whether it can be changed and how I can stay today.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the booking date and separately discuss changes and accommodation for today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認担当へおつなぎします。荷物をまとめてこちらでお待ちください。旅程を整理してから進めましょう。担当者に引き継ぎましたので、私はここで失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the staff who can check. Please gather your luggage and wait here. Let us clarify your itinerary before proceeding. I have handed you over to the staff, so I will excuse myself here.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 集合場所は、この散策用の図で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can check the meeting point on this walking map.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 緑の印に集合と聞いたのですが、私には図の色が見分けにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 集合の色印を見分けにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard we are meeting at the green mark, but I find the map's colors hard to distinguish.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have difficulty distinguishing the meeting-point color mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文字の番号と目印でも説明しましょう。図にある「集合Ａ」という文字は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain it using written numbers and landmarks too. Can you read “Meeting A” on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文字なら読めます。でも道の分かれ目が二つあるので、どちらか迷いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字は読めるが二つの分岐で迷いそうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can read the words. But there are two forks in the path, so I may be unsure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can read the words but may get confused by the two forks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この学習用の図では、案内板がある分かれ目を目印にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this learning map, we use the fork with the information board as a landmark.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内板に書かれた名前も、紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目印の案内板名を書面にしてもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you write the name on that information board on paper too?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the landmark information board's name in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前と図の番号を書きます。迷ったら無理に先へ進まず、連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will write the name and map number. If you get lost, do not force yourself to continue; contact us.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で図の番号を伝えれば、場所を説明しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話で図の番号を伝える方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I give the map number over the phone, it will be easier to explain the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the method of giving the map number by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうですね。通話が難しい場合に備えて、同行者との連絡方法も決めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us also decide how to contact your companion in case a call is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者にこの紙を見せます。見つけられなければ、出発前に案内所で待ち合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者へ紙を示し見つからなければ案内所で出発前に会うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show my companion this paper. If I cannot find the place, we will meet at the information center before setting out.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show your companion the paper and meet at the information center before departure if you cannot find the place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 文字と目印で確認できるようになりましたね。合流してから、無理のない散策をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now you can check using words and landmarks. After meeting up, enjoy a walk that is comfortable for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物用の商品をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くに住む友人に送ります。割れにくくて、軽いものを予算内で選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠方への贈り物として軽く割れにくい予算内の商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will send it to a friend who lives far away. I want something light and not easily broken, within my budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a light, hard-to-break item within your budget as a gift to send far away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの二つはいかがですか。価格の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: How about these two? Please also look at the prices displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さいほうが予算に合います。この見本の色と、箱の中の色は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予算内の小商品を選び見本と箱内の色が同じか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: The smaller one fits my budget. Is the color of this sample the same as the one inside the box?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the small item within your budget and ask whether the sample and boxed item colors match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の表示を確認します。包装前に商品を確認するご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the box label. Would you like to check the product before wrapping?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 色を確かめてから包んでください。友人に渡す紙も中に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色を見てから包装し渡す紙も入れたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please wrap it after I check the color. I would also like to put a note for my friend inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the color before wrapping and include a note for the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙を入れる位置は担当者とご相談ください。価格がわかるものの扱いも確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss where to put the note with the staff in charge. Would you also like to check what to do with anything showing the price?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額がわかる札をどうするか知りたいです。商品名の表示は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 価格札の扱いを聞き商品名表示は残したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to know how the price tag is handled. I want to leave the product name label in place.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with the price tag and say that you want to retain the product name label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な表示を残せるか、包装担当者に確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the wrapping staff whether the required labeling can be retained and explain it.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてから包装をお願いします。送るときの箱は自分で用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に包装を頼み発送箱は自分で用意すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please wrap it after I hear the explanation. I will prepare the shipping box myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request wrapping after the explanation and say that you will provide the shipping box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 包装前の確認から進めます。ご友人に喜んでいただける贈り物になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will start with the checks before wrapping. I hope it will be a gift your friend enjoys.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学の計画について、どのようなことを確認なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about your visit plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人六人で行く計画です。個人で行く場合と、連絡の方法が違うか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 六人での来館が個人と異なる連絡方法になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are planning to come as six friends. I would like to know whether the contact arrangements differ from visiting individually.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a six-person visit requires different contact arrangements from an individual visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人数や希望内容に応じた扱いは、担当窓口に確認しましょう。何か依頼したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check with the responsible desk about arrangements according to your numbers and wishes. Is there anything you would like to request?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全員で説明を聞けるか相談したいです。ただ、来館日はまだ候補が二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全員で説明を聞きたく来館候補日は二つあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: We would like to discuss whether everyone can hear an explanation together. But we still have two possible dates for the visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that everyone wants to hear an explanation and there are two candidate dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補日と希望を整理してお問い合わせください。開催や対応を今ここでお約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please organize your candidate dates and wishes before inquiring. We cannot promise here and now that it will take place or be accommodated.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最新の開館情報も確認したいので、問い合わせ先をメモしていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最新の開館情報と問い合わせ先を記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also want to check the latest opening information. May I note the inquiry contact?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the latest opening information and record the inquiry contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口の確認方法をご案内します。お伝えする項目もまとめますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain how to find the responsible contact. I will also summarize what you should tell them.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人数、候補日、説明を希望することを伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数と候補日と説明希望の三点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Should I tell them the number of people, possible dates, and that we would like an explanation?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the three points: numbers, candidate dates, and request for an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まずその三点からご相談ください。担当者が追加で確認することもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please start with those three points. The staff may ask for additional information.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の都合をそろえてから問い合わせます。返事をもらうまでは日程を確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の都合を整理して連絡し返答まで日程を確定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will inquire after coordinating my friends' availability. I will not finalize the schedule until we receive a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will coordinate friends' availability and contact them, without fixing the schedule before a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 希望を整理していただくと相談しやすくなります。準備ができましたら、担当窓口へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Organizing your wishes makes it easier to discuss. When ready, please contact the responsible desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符について、予定されている乗り方を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Regarding tickets, could you tell me how you plan to travel?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達の家まで往復する予定です。先に往復分を買えばよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人宅への往復予定で先に切符を買うべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to go to my friend's house and back. Should I buy tickets for both directions first?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to buy tickets in advance for your planned trip to a friend's house and back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入方法や使える切符は、区間などを確認してご案内します。途中で別の場所にも立ち寄りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the route and other details before explaining purchasing methods and eligible tickets. Will you stop anywhere else along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰りに買い物へ行くかもしれません。まだ店が決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの買い物先がまだ決まっていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I may go shopping on the way back. I have not decided on a shop yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not decided where to shop on the way back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 寄り道がある場合は、最初の往復の想定と乗る回数が変わるかもしれませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you make a detour, the number of journeys may differ from the original round-trip plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先を決めてから種類を比べたいです。このメモに順番を書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き先を決めてメモに順序を書き切符を比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to decide the destinations before comparing ticket types. May I write the sequence in this note?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to decide destinations, note their sequence, and compare tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行く場所の順番と予定日を書いていただくと確認できます。料金も担当者に照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check if you write the order of places and planned date. Let us ask the staff about fares too.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 安さだけで選ばず、使える範囲と買い方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金以外に使用範囲と購入方法も聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want to choose by cheapness alone. I also want to ask about where the ticket can be used and how to buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that besides price, you want to ask about the area of validity and purchase method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その条件を確かめてからお選びください。今は購入前の相談でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check those conditions before choosing. For now, is this a consultation before purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は相談だけにします。友達と寄り道の場所を決めてから、メモを持って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今は買わず友人と寄り道先を決めてからメモで確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now, just advice. I will decide the detour with my friend, then bring my note to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not buy now, but decide the detour with your friend and then check using your note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 行程が決まりましたら、使える切符を改めてご相談ください。どうぞお友達とのお出かけを楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once your itinerary is decided, please ask us again about usable tickets. Enjoy your outing with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に伝票をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the bill before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で二人が別々に追加したので、注文した数がわからなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人が別々に追加し注文数がわからなくなったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: The two of us added things separately during the meal, so we have lost track of how many items we ordered.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that two people added orders separately and you lost track of the quantities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品名ごとに確認しましょう。最初のご注文は覚えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check each item. Do you remember the initial order?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初は定食が二つです。そのあと一人が小鉢を頼みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最初の定食二つと後の小鉢を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two set meals at first. After that, one person ordered a small side dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two original set meals and later side dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 伝票にはその小鉢があります。もう一人の追加は何でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: That side dish is on the bill. What did the other person add?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ご飯を追加したと思いますが、本人に聞いて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ご飯と思われる追加を注文者本人へ確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think it was extra rice, but I will ask the person who ordered it to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the likely extra rice order with the person who placed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れ様に確認してから、こちらの数と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking with your companion, let us compare it with these quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ご飯で合っていました。伝票の数も合います。会計は一人がまとめて払ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ご飯の確認と数の一致を伝えてまとめ払いの可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was rice. The bill quantities match too. May one of us pay for everything together?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the rice and matching quantities, then ask whether one person can pay the full bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この学習店舗の会計方法を確認してご案内します。お支払い後の控えは必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check this learning shop's payment methods and explain. Do you need a receipt after paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まとめ払いの方法を聞いて、控えをもらいます。友人との分担はあとで決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まとめ払い方法を確認し控えを受け取り分担は後で決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask how to pay together and take a receipt. We will decide how to split it between friends afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the combined-payment method, get a receipt, and decide the split later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは確認した内容で会計を進めます。ご来店ありがとうございました。皆様お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will proceed with the checked bill. Thank you for visiting. Please all take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の清掃は図に示した二つの区画を担当してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: For this morning's cleaning, please handle the two sections shown in the diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最後の区画名が機械の音で聞こえませんでした。もう一度確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 機械音で最後の区画名が聞こえず再確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I could not hear the last section name because of the machinery. I would like to check it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that machinery noise prevented you hearing the last section name and you want to check again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 指示を聞き取れないまま始めず、こちらの確認場所で図を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not start without understanding the instruction. Let us look at the diagram at this checking point.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図のＡとＣだと思いましたが、Ｂではないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ＡとＣと思ったがＢかもしれないと図で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was A and C on the diagram, but could it be B?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the diagram to ask whether it might be B, although you thought A and C. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当はＡとＢです。Ｃは別の作業中なので、入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your sections are A and B. Other work is in progress in C, so do not enter it.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ＡとＢの清掃で、Ｃには入らないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当はＡとＢでＣには入らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I clean A and B and do not go into C.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you are assigned A and B and must not enter C. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その理解で合っています。道具を運ぶ経路も、この図で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is correct. Please also check the route for carrying tools on this diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この矢印の道を使い、途中の柵を越えないという理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 矢印の道を使い柵を越えない理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Am I right that I use the route shown by this arrow and do not cross the fence along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that you use the arrowed route and do not cross the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経路で説明しています。ただし現地で状況が違っていたら、その場で責任者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is the route we are describing. But if conditions differ on site, check with the supervisor there.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当と経路を確認できました。表示が変わっていたら作業を止め、責任者に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当と経路を理解し現地表示が変われば止めて責任者に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed my assignment and route. If the signs have changed, I will stop work and ask the supervisor.
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you understand the assignment and route and will stop to ask the supervisor if site signs have changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 復唱した内容を確認しました。無理に判断せず、指示された範囲で進めてください。では、次の確認に向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-039-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have checked what you repeated. Do not force a judgment yourself; work within the instructed area. I will move on to the next check.
